Features.Title: More supplier invoices recognized
Features.Description: AK Wholesale and other supported supplier PDFs now account for printed taxes, shipping and discounts when checking invoice totals. The next normal email check rechecks recent attachments automatically. Existing purchases are protected against duplicates. For older invoices, open Invoice Inbox, select Include month and Check Invoices. PDFs needing corrections remain available in Needs Review.

Features.Title: Product costs and price history by period
Features.Description: Product Costs and Price Alerts now have visible Current Month, Previous Month, Current Year, Previous Year and Custom period choices. Price changes compare purchases in invoice-date order, including older invoices imported later. Missing comparisons from saved invoice lines are rebuilt once when you open either section. Two purchases of the same product and pack size are needed to show a change.

Features.Title: Opening cash reminder only after Month Close
Features.Description: Closing a completed month enables one opening-cash reminder for the next month. Dismissing it is remembered across restarts. A month already in progress will no longer trigger daily reminders. You can still use Set Carry Forward when ready.
